description: This Java class 'MerchantConfig' models configuration settings for a merchant in an e-commerce system. It includes various display options, default search configurations, and serialization to JSON.

classes.name: MerchantConfig
classes.description: Serializable and JSON-aware model class representing merchant-specific configuration settings such as display options and search configurations.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the MerchantConfig object into a JSON string representation.

methods.name: setDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Sets whether the customer section is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayCustomerSection
methods.description: Checks if the customer section is displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Sets whether the 'Contact Us' section is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayContactUs
methods.description: Checks if the 'Contact Us' section is displayed.

methods.name: setDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Sets whether the store address is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayStoreAddress
methods.description: Checks if the store address is displayed.

methods.name: setUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Sets the default search configuration map.

methods.name: getUseDefaultSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the default search configuration map.

methods.name: setDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Sets the file path map for default search configurations.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchConfigPath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path map for default search configurations.

methods.name: setDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Sets whether the 'Add to Cart' option on featured items is displayed.

methods.name: isDisplayAddToCartOnFeaturedItems
methods.description: Checks if the 'Add to Cart' option on featured items is displayed.
